Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities against human single-protein target CHEMBL1293295 (Ubiquitin carboxyl-terminal hydrolase 14). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Require exact standard relation '=' and non-null pChEMBL values. Inner join compound_structures to include canonical SMILES. Order results by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID. Return the first 1000 rows.
